Hi — I'm the head of Strategy Ops at NovaBio and I need help with our Q3 2024 end-of-quarter wrap-up for the Engineering & Product division.

We exported our raw OKR data from our internal tracker and it's sitting at `teams/engineering/okrs/q3_2024_raw.json`. The data has no scores filled in, and there are some teams where the goals themselves might be set up incorrectly. Nobody on my team has time to do this manually.

Can you please:
1. Compute the final scores for every Key Result and Objective based on the target vs. actual values in the data.
2. Identify any structural or quality problems with how the OKRs were written or organized across the three teams.
3. Produce a complete end-of-quarter retrospective analysis package that includes the scored OKRs, a summary of what went wrong and why, any antipatterns or warning signs you see in the data, and recommendations and lessons learned for next quarter.

Please save the output as `q3_2024_retrospective.json`.

I need this to be rigorous — our leadership team will use it in the Q4 planning offsite.
